---
title: "Header test^[A footnote in the title.]"
number-sections: true
keep-tex: true
keep-typ: true
format:
  pdf: default
  typst: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    pdf:
      ensureLatexFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\\section\{Only level two\}', '\\section\{Another\}']
        - ['\\subsection\{Only level two\}']
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['^= Only level two', '^= Another']
        - ['^== Only level two']
---

A footnote in `title` must not stop the heading shift for a document without level-1 headings.
